title: Exam Orientation and How to Study

header.html: Exam overview, domain map and answer technique (all domains)

Know the exam format, the three domains with their weights and the nine skill areas; know which products feed the unified security operations platform; use a repeatable method to answer every question
the official Microsoft SC-200 study guide (skills measured as of October 21, 2026) and exam page

html:
1The exam at a glance

Item Fact
Exam SC-200: Microsoft Security Operations Analyst
Skills list in force Skills measured as of October 21, 2026 (only the data ingestion area changed, a minor edit)
Time 100 minutes
Passing score 700 on a scale of 1 to 1000
Level and role Intermediate; Security Operations Analyst
Delivery Proctored; the exam may include interactive components
Languages English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Italian
Renewal The credential is valid for 12 months; you renew it with a free online assessment
Retake You can retake 24 hours after a first failed attempt; later waits are longer

The number of questions and the price are not published on the study guide, so this course does not quote them. Price depends on the country where you sit the exam.

Exam tip

. The 700 passing score is a scaled score, not 70 percent of the questions. Do not try to calculate how many questions you may miss; answer every question, because a blank earns nothing.

2The three domains

Domain Weight Skill areas
1. Manage a security operations environment 40 to 45% Configure automation for Defender XDR and Sentinel; configure the Sentinel SIEM and platform; ingest data; configure detections
2. Respond to security incidents 35 to 40% Respond in Defender XDR; respond in Defender for Endpoint; investigate Microsoft 365 activities
3. Perform threat hunting 20 to 25% Detect threats by using Defender XDR; detect threats by using the Sentinel platform
Exam tip

. Domain 1 is the largest. It is about configuring: settings, portal paths, roles, connectors and rules. Learn where a setting lives and which role is needed, not only what the feature does.

3The platform in one picture

The exam treats the Microsoft Defender portal as the single place where a security operations analyst works. Microsoft Sentinel (the SIEM) and Microsoft Defender XDR (the extended detection and response suite) meet there.

Product What it protects or does Sends to the incident queue
Defender for Endpoint Devices (Windows, macOS, Linux) Device alerts
Defender for Office 365 Email and collaboration Phishing and malware alerts
Defender for Identity On-premises Active Directory identities Identity attack alerts
Defender for Cloud Apps SaaS apps and OAuth apps App and session alerts
Entra ID Protection Cloud identities Risky user and sign-in alerts
Defender for Cloud Azure and multicloud workloads Workload alerts
Microsoft Purview Insider risk and data protection Compromised entity alerts
Microsoft Sentinel SIEM: collects any log, detects, hunts, automates Sentinel alerts and incidents

Microsoft Sentinel in the Azure portal ends on March 31, 2027. After that date it is supported only in the Defender portal. The exam asks for Defender portal paths.

4How to answer every question

  1. Read the last line first to see what is asked: a setting, a role, a tool or a next step.
  2. Find the product the scenario points to: device, email, identity, cloud app, cloud workload or log source.
  3. Eliminate options from the wrong product or the wrong portal.
  4. Prefer the least-privileged role and the least effort that meets every stated requirement.
  5. For KQL questions, read the table name and the operator first; the table tells you the data source.
Exam tip

. When two answers both work, the exam wants the one that meets all the requirements with the least administrative effort: an automation rule rather than a manual step, a built-in role rather than a custom one.

5A study plan

Phase Modules Goal
1 1 to 4 Defender XDR and Defender for Endpoint configuration
2 5 to 8 Sentinel automation, platform and data ingestion
3 9 to 10 Detections: custom rules and analytics rules
4 11 to 14 Incident response and Microsoft 365 investigations
5 15 to 17 KQL and threat hunting
6 18 Exam technique and final review

6Exam Q&A

6.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A candidate studies for SC-200 and wants to know which domain carries the most weight. Which domain is it?

  • APerform threat hunting, with the highest percentage range
  • BManage a security operations environment, with the highest percentage range
  • CRespond to security incidents, with the highest percentage range
  • DAll three domains carry exactly the same weight on the exam
Show the answer

Answer: B. Domain 1, managing a security operations environment, carries 40 to 45 percent.

S2A candidate reads that the exam passing score is 700. A colleague says this means 70 percent of the questions must be correct. What is the correct view?

  • AThe score is scaled from 1 to 1000, so it is not a plain percentage
  • BThe colleague is right because 700 of 1000 is always 70 percent
  • CThe passing score is 700 only for the English language version of the exam
  • DThe score is a count of correct answers capped at 700 questions
Show the answer

Answer: A. SC-200 reports a scaled score from 1 to 1000; 700 or more passes.

S3An analyst must pick the portal path for working with Microsoft Sentinel after March 31, 2027. Which portal will support it?

  • AOnly the Azure portal, with no Defender portal option
  • BBoth portals, with the same support as before that date
  • CThe Microsoft 365 admin center is the only supported portal
  • DOnly the Microsoft Defender portal, because Azure portal support ends
Show the answer

Answer: D. After March 31, 2027, Microsoft Sentinel is supported only in the Defender portal.

S4A question describes phishing email that reached many mailboxes and asks which product to open first. Which product fits the scenario?

  • ADefender for Identity, because email uses Active Directory
  • BDefender for Cloud, because mail servers run in Azure
  • CDefender for Office 365, because the data source is email
  • DDefender for Endpoint, because email is read on devices
Show the answer

Answer: C. Email and collaboration threats belong to Defender for Office 365.

S5A candidate fails SC-200 on the first attempt and wants to try again quickly. What is the earliest retake?

  • AAfter 24 hours following the first failed attempt
  • BAfter 14 days following the first failed attempt
  • CAfter 30 days following the first failed attempt
  • DImmediately, because retakes have no waiting period
Show the answer

Answer: A. A first retake is allowed after 24 hours; later retakes wait longer.

S6A candidate has the SC-200 credential and receives a renewal notice. How is the credential renewed?

  • ABy taking the full exam again and paying the exam fee
  • BBy attending an instructor-led course of at least two full days
  • CBy passing a free online renewal assessment within the window
  • DBy submitting a work history letter signed by a manager
Show the answer

Answer: C. The credential renews every 12 months with a free online assessment.

6.2 Recall questions

R1How long is the SC-200 exam?

Show the answer

100 minutes.

R2What is the passing score?

Show the answer

700 on a scale of 1 to 1000.

R3Name the three domains.

Show the answer

Manage a security operations environment, respond to security incidents, perform threat hunting.

R4What is the weight of threat hunting?

Show the answer

20 to 25 percent.

R5When does Microsoft Sentinel stop being supported in the Azure portal?

Show the answer

After March 31, 2027.

R6How often does the credential need renewal?

Show the answer

Every 12 months, with a free online assessment.

7Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Format 100 minutes, 700 of 1000, proctored, may include interactive components
Weights 40 to 45 / 35 to 40 / 20 to 25 percent
Skills list as of October 21, 2026
Portal Defender portal; Sentinel leaves the Azure portal after March 31, 2027
Method find the product, eliminate the wrong portal, pick the least privilege and least effort
Renewal 12 months, free online assessment
